text: 7.2 1. Good teachers can be an inspiration to their class and encourage them to do well. 2. Sir, would you mind if I asked you a question about education? 3. Maria Montessori was an Italian woman who developed an approach to educate the whole child. Four Of course, the teacher can give encouragement and try to inspire the class, but if a child won't cooperate, then there's little we can do. Five So it's all about cooperation between teachers and families.
